response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(qc_count) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(qc_count) FROM c) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM c ORDER BY qc_count DESC

assumptions.assumption: A NULL fundflux forms its own group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), and it counts as one group in the average count per funding source. Empty-string fundflux values, if any, are kept as a separate group and not merged with NULL.
The average count per funding source is the mean of the per-group counts over groups that have at least one matched QC record; funding sources with no QC records are not included.
